title: Blue Notebook Review - Cadet Alexis Signs Off
description:
This week’s Blue Notebook (May 3-9) has a little bit of everything: goodbyes, hellos, traffic stops, graffiti arrests, outreach updates, a 5K, an award, and a reminder to be kind. Basically, a full SMPD group chat in video form.

Highlights:

🚔 Crime Suppression
2528 calls for service and 106 arrests, including the recovery of a child involved in an abduction and 4 arrests tied to active graffiti tagging. A handgun was also recovered.

🏍️ Traffic Safety
472 traffic stops, 305 citations, motorcycle safety operations, and 76 voluntary breath test demos during our “Know Your Limits” DUI education campaign. Because traffic safety is not just about tickets. It is about keeping people alive.

🤝 Homeless Outreach
153 radio calls, 138 self-initiated contacts, 10 arrests, 27 citations, and 7 encampments addressed. Officers also used a mobile fingerprint reader to identify a person who provided a false name and was wanted for felony probation violation.

🌟 Community Engagement
We stopped by the Rick Crocker 5K Challenge, celebrated Officer Anthony Angel’s recognition from the Santa Monica-Malibu PTA, and shared details about the Downtown Substation ribbon cutting on May 28 at noon.

Also: Cadet Alexis signs off, Cadet Naomi steps in, and yes, Sgt. Rick still manages to keep the whole thing moving.

Watch the full episode and, as always, choose kindness. A small gesture can brighten someone’s day.
